name: Minimalist Swiss International Typographic Architecture
designThesis: Objective clarity rooted in the 1950s Swiss International Typographic Style. Enforces mathematical grid systems, asymmetrical balance, grotesque typography, and stark monochrome contrast with zero unnecessary ornamentation.
bestFitContexts: Editorial research archives and documentation portals
Fine art and typography foundry catalogs

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Stark monochrome canvas (#ffffff in light; #121212 / #000000 in dark)
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Single high-contrast functional accent (e.g., Swiss Vermilion #E63946 or International Klein Blue #002FA7) reserved strictly for key actions
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA across all text elements

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Inter, Helvetica Neue, or Space Grotesk paired with clean system sans
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: High-contrast scale with heavy bold display weights (700-900) against regular body (400)

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Strict 12-column asymmetric grid with visible or mathematically aligned cell divisions

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px to 2px solid hairline borders with zero blur
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Flat 2D surfaces with zero drop-shadows; elevation expressed through border hierarchy

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Sharp rectangular buttons with solid high-contrast fill and instant hover inversion
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Grid-aligned content containers with clear structural divider lines and no nested card clutter
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Clean border-bottom data rows with monospace tabular figures

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: High-visibility 3px solid focus ring with 2px offset

antiPatterns: Drop shadows or blurred lighting effects
Rounded pill buttons with large border-radii
Low-contrast gray text on off-white surfaces

browserChecks: Verify strict 0px border radius and sharp borders at all breakpoints
Verify high-contrast 7:1 text against stark monochrome canvas
Verify LTR to RTL bidirectional symmetry
